design_notes: 600-minute nonstops are not 'over 10 hours' (strict, lines 211-212). Between 5 and 10 hours business needs one of the three cases of lines 205-210, and none holds (the dialogue starts two days later, economy seats are free, no medical grounds); read 'between' as exclusive and no line allows business either. Economy at the lowest practical fare (line 187); the manager's yes was only 'if the policy allows it'.
